name: Nozoicha Dame! ~Dokidoki Joshiryou Kansatsu~
original_name: 覗いちゃだめっ！～ドキドキ女子寮かんさつ～
source:
Main character has to live alone due to parents circumstances. He rents an apartment owned by his relatives cheaply and goes to school. However, girls from school start to visit this place and renovate it little by little ending with renaming it to "Women's Dormitory". Protagonist soon finds himself living alongside many girls and bumping into them at every corner.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角由于父母的原因不得不独自生活。他以低价租下了亲戚名下的公寓，继续上学。然而，学校的女孩们开始光顾这个地方，一点一点地改造它，最后将其更名为"女生宿舍"。主角很快发现自己和许多女孩生活在一起，在每个角落都会和她们撞个满怀。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
